description: This file defines the DataSyncService class responsible for synchronizing local data with a remote source. It manages sync operations, detecting conflicts, applying remote changes, and updating sync timestamps. The file includes data classes for representing sync results, syncable items, and conflicts, as well as methods for handling the synchronization process.

classes.name: DataSyncService
classes.description: Main class responsible for data synchronization between local database and remote source.

classes.name: SyncResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing the outcomes of a sync operation, including start, success, error, or conflicts.

classes.name: SyncableItem
classes.description: Abstract representation of an item that can be synchronized, with subclasses for different data types.

classes.name: SyncConflict
classes.description: Data class representing a conflict between local and remote syncable items.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Performs the synchronization process, handling conflict detection, applying remote changes, and updating timestamps.

methods.name: getLocalChanges
methods.description: Retrieves local changes made after a specified timestamp from the local database.

methods.name: getRemoteChanges
methods.description: Fetches remote data changes since a given timestamp (stub for remote fetch logic).

methods.name: findConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts between local and remote items based on last modified timestamps.

methods.name: applyRemoteChanges
methods.description: Applies remote changes to the local database.

methods.name: getLastSyncTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last successful sync from shared preferences.

methods.name: updateLastSyncTime
methods.description: Updates the last sync timestamp in shared preferences to the current system time.
